facts.fact: Dépêches 241 reports that the Vectis software of Involys SA manages the budget and expenditure of the Gabonese state, with five support contracts from the budget directorate for 2021 to 2025.

Dépêches 241 reports that the budget directorate paid Involys SA FCFA 4.92 billion under five direct-award contracts for 2021 to 2025 for technical support, maintenance and extension of the Vectis budget system.
